serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #bot.Expression.clear You: Listen {f_botName}, we need to find a way to deal with our neighbor. #bot.Expression.blush Bot: You mean that stuff about people hearing us when we…{{wi}} you know… You: Yeah. Bot: Well, first, we would need to pinpoint which neighbor or neighbors are responsible for telling the Landlord. #bot.Expression.clear You: Do you have any ideas how to do it? Bot: A few. Bot: We could play a recording of these sounds wall by wall and see which one results in Landlord coming here. You: That would make me lose another 500$, but I guess there’s no choice, unless you have other ideas? Bot: Other ones are a little more invasive. That doesn’t sound good… God knows what she came up with… You: I can live with losing another 500$. Let’s do this. #bot.Expression.blush #bot.Expression.happy Bot: Sure, but there’s one problem… You: What is it? Bot: First we need to gather some sound samples… You: Oh. You: … You: Okay! Let’s do it!
